metadata.title: Fulvestrant Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Post-menopausal women with ER-positive locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after relapse or progression on / after adjuvant anti-oestrogen therapy, as written in NCCP00361.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: Current official PDF downloaded; header/version reviewed; rendered page 2 organ-function table visually inspected.
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled rule encoding · independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and Irish/EU product sources reviewed, including monitoring provenance, unresolved dose-source differences and treatment-specific safety. Independent clinical/pharmacy validation remains pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: NCCP schedule: 500 mg on Days 1 and 15 of the first 28-day cycle, then Day 1 of each 28-day cycle. This means Day 29 next, then every 28 days.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

action.message: Source conflict: NCCP Table 1 recommends 50% of the original 500 mg dose (250 mg) for Child-Pugh B, while current EMA Faslodex §4.2 recommends no reduction for mild/moderate hepatic impairment with caution. Consultant and oncology pharmacy must reconcile the product, liver status and actual prior dose before prescribing. No definitive numeric dose is calculated.

rules.explanation: Source conflict: NCCP Table 1 recommends 50% of the original 500 mg dose (250 mg) for Child-Pugh B, while current EMA Faslodex §4.2 recommends no reduction for mild/moderate hepatic impairment with caution. supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP endocrine monotherapy: minimal emetogenic risk, no routine prophylactic antiemetics.
summary: Minimal emetic risk; no routine prophylactic antiemetic or steroid premedication. Provide symptom-directed treatment and medicine-specific counselling.

indications.description: Post-menopausal ER-positive locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer relapsing on/after adjuvant anti-oestrogen therapy.
Post-menopausal ER-positive locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer progressing on/after adjuvant anti-oestrogen therapy (NCCP wording).

administration.notes: Two 5 mL injections, one into each buttock, 1–2 minutes per injection. Use trained staff and sciatic-nerve precautions.
Two 5 mL injections, one into each buttock, 1–2 minutes per injection. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2).
Confirm indication/menopausal status, pregnancy exclusion, liver category and IM bleeding risk.
regular: Liver profile when clinically indicated (NCCP p2).
At injections, review tolerability, bruising/bleeding and injection-site nerve symptoms. No NCCP-mandated generic pre-dose ANC or platelet threshold.
monitoring.disease: Response imaging and other tests follow the consultant treatment plan. NCCP does not prescribe a fixed CT or tumour-marker interval.
monitoring.not_routine: No universal ECG, echocardiogram or repeated full blood count schedule is specified for fulvestrant monotherapy. Do not copy CDK4/6 combination monitoring onto this card.
monitoring.bone: Potential osteoporosis risk is described in the SmPC; assess individual fracture risk and bone-health plan. No fixed drug-specific DXA interval is mandated here.

dose_modifications: Child-Pugh B: NCCP proposes250mg/50% original dose, whereas EMA gives no mild/moderate reduction with caution. This unresolved source conflict produces specialist review without a definitive calculated dose.
Child-Pugh C / severe hepatic impairment: do not administer.
CrCl ≥30: no adjustment. CrCl <30 / dialysis: none expected in NCCP table but severe impairment requires caution.

source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: EMA Faslodex §4.2 recommends no dose reduction for mild/moderate impairment with caution. The conflicting NCCP 250 mg recommendation remains visible as source text; automatic numeric output is blocked pending Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation.
EMA describes intervals of one month plus extra dose2weeks afterinitial; patient graphics use exact NCCP q28 schedule.

source_discrepancies.nccp: Both indication lines refer to prior adjuvant anti-oestrogen treatment.
source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: EMA includes endocrine-naive monotherapy and progression on anti-oestrogen therapy; card does not silently expand NCCP mapping.
